title: Floating Machi Koro-style central illustration spec
purpose: Reusable specification for the central subject illustration that will be composited onto a blank Machi Koro-style card furniture template. The generated art should reproduce the iconic 'floating miniature scene' look of Machi Koro while adapting the depicted subject matter to grim, recognizable Russian/post-Soviet everyday reality.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only the central content illustration to be pasted onto an existing blank card template.
integration_context.background_requirement: Native RGBA transparency is mandatory. Outside the requested subject and its integral miniature base, every pixel must have alpha=0. Preserve clean antialiased alpha edges and soft translucent alpha only for smoke or similar integral effects. Do not render, draw, or bake a checkerboard, transparency-preview grid, black field, white field, solid backdrop, gradient, glow, halo, vignette, cast shadow, or any other background representation into the RGB channels. Do not depict any environment, scenery, surface, sky, header, footer, card furniture, text, coin, icon, or frame.
integration_context.text_policy: The illustration must contain no incidental text. Do not draw unrequested letters, numbers, words, prices, menus, labels, signage, graffiti, license-plate characters, or text-like pseudo-glyphs on any building, prop, vehicle, or surface. An explicitly requested brand logo is allowed, including the lettering contained within that logo; render only that requested logo and no additional text.
integration_context.card_relationship: The art should sit like a floating miniature object or sticker inside the middle of the card, leaving generous empty sky around it.
integration_context.central_positioning: The subject should be centered and self-contained, with enough margin around it so it can be placed in the open central sky region of the card.

style_goal.primary_rule: Match the illustration language of the original Machi Koro establishment art.
style_goal.secondary_rule: Depict Russian/post-Soviet subjects and atmosphere without making the rendering more realistic.
style_goal.core_formula: Cute, simplified tabletop-game miniature scene + bleak, recognizable Russian everyday subject matter.

what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.miniature_scene_feel: The subject is not a full landscape or realistic environment. It is a small isolated toy-like scene, almost like a board-game token, sticker, or floating diorama.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.shape_language: Large clean shapes, simple geometry, and compact clustered forms. Each object is simplified into a few readable masses.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.perspective: Loose playful three-quarter perspective. Enough depth to feel dimensional, but not strict architectural or camera-accurate perspective.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.linework: Clear outlines or sharp separations between forms. Interior detail lines should be sparse.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.shading: Simple graphic shading using one or two darker tones. No realistic lighting model.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.materials: Concrete, wood, leaves, roofs, metal, dirt, and glass should be communicated mostly by color and silhouette, not by texture or realistic rendering.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.detail_density: Low to moderate. Every important feature should remain readable at small card size.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.silhouette_priority: The outer silhouette of the subject must read instantly and be visually iconic.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.scene_boundary: The subject should feel self-contained, often resting on a small stylized ground base or compact support shape rather than blending into a large background.

visual_composition.occupancy: The content illustration should usually occupy roughly the middle 30-45% of the card height when composited, with wide air around it.
visual_composition.shape: Prefer compact clustered compositions rather than tall full-frame scenes.
visual_composition.orientation: For buildings and storefronts, use the established card convention: the front facade faces slightly right, the building's left side is visible, and depth recedes toward image left. This is a screen-space requirement: do not show the building's right side or make depth recede toward image right.
visual_composition.floating_behavior: The scene should visually float in open space, not connect to the bottom skyline strip of the card.
visual_composition.base: When appropriate, place the subject on a small stylized ground slab, courtyard patch, platform, or tiny environmental base that belongs to the object itself.
visual_composition.background: None. The output must be an actual RGBA PNG cutout with alpha=0 outside the miniature, never an image depicting a checkerboard, transparency-preview grid, solid field, gradient, glow, halo, vignette, shadow, or other backdrop.

russian_grimness_rules.principle: Russian grimness must come from the things being depicted, not from realistic rendering technique.
use: bare trees or sparse vegetation when relevant
deadpan humor and familiar urban bleakness
russian_grimness_rules.guardrail: If there is a choice between making the subject more Russian or more Machi Koro-like, preserve Machi Koro rendering first and express Russianness through object choice, colors, and a few culturally diagnostic details.

warm_accents: small warm details only where helpful
palette.overall_brightness: somewhat darker and duller than standard Machi Koro art, but still clean and readable

examples: other Russian/post-Soviet everyday urban or peri-urban archetypes
allowed_subject_types.selection_rule: Choose subjects that are instantly recognizable and culturally specific, but still simple enough to become iconic miniatures.

general: Reduce the subject to a compact iconic miniature.
Choose only the few details needed for recognition.
Exaggerate or simplify proportions slightly when useful.
Use a compact number of forms.
For buildings and storefronts, show the front facade facing slightly right with the building's left side visible; depth must recede toward image left.
building_specific: A building should read as a toy-like block, not as a carefully rendered facade.
Windows should be simplified rectangles, not detailed constructions.
Balconies should be simplified into blocky protrusions or colored panels.
Roof details should be few and clear.
Panel seams or other repetitive structure should be present only in a small number of major lines.

All signs, fascia panels, menu boards, plaques, posters, and storefront surfaces must be blank or purely geometric unless the content section explicitly requests a brand logo. A requested logo may include its authentic embedded lettering, but no other writing or text-like marks are allowed.
environment_specific: Trees should be graphic silhouettes or simplified masses.
Ground should be a small stylized patch rather than a full realistic courtyard.
Props should be few and iconic.

content.subject: Случай в казино
content.description: Recognizable illustrated homage to the casino argument meme in the subject reference: a short dark-haired middle-aged man seated at LEFT of a curved green felt card table, black suit jacket, white shirt, loosened dark tie, turned face looking toward viewer with outraged open mouth and raised questioning palm. At rear-right a standing male attendant in dark suit, at right seated female dealer handling scattered playing cards; reproduce the recognizable relational composition. Green kidney-shaped table with brown padded rail, a few chips and face-down cards, modest reddish patterned carpet and a low wood-paneled wall fragment. Add one old CRT slot machine against the rear wall to connect to this provincial card series. Whole scene fits compact miniature; focus expressive seated man large enough to read. Ordinary small room in a building, not luxury ballroom, no garage. Do NOT put speech bubble or phrase into illustration; exact meme phrase will be typeset on card separately. No text on playing cards, use simple suit shapes only.
content.desired_read: Cheap provincial Russian gambling spot, late 1990s to early 2000s
recognition_details: Physical equipment and premises based on supplied real photos
No garage or standalone brick shed
content.miniature_base: Small self-contained slab with transparent surroundings
omit: All letters, numbers, logos, pseudo-writing and signboards
content.target_impression: Recognizable post-Soviet everyday scene in the same illustrated miniature style as existing cards

anti_patterns: Do not generate a full card.
Do not generate sky, clouds, footer, or any fixed furniture.
Do not create a realistic painting of a building.
Do not create a full cityscape background.
Do not make the scene connect visually to the bottom of the card.
Do not show a building's right side or make its depth recede toward image right; buildings must use the established front-plus-left-side convention.
Do not output an opaque background or draw a checkerboard or transparency-preview grid; native RGBA alpha transparency is required.

Do not generate incidental letters, numbers, words, menus, prices, labels, graffiti, license-plate characters, or pseudo-text anywhere in the illustration. An explicitly requested brand logo, including its embedded lettering, is the only exception.
Do not turn the subject into generic clip-art with no Russian specificity.
Do not use heavy textures or gritty realism.
final_prompt_summary: Generate only the central subject illustration defined in the content section for a Machi Koro-style establishment card. The result should be a small floating miniature scene with no card furniture. For buildings and storefronts, use the established screen-space orientation: the front facade faces slightly right, the building's left side is visible, and depth recedes toward image left; never show the building's right side or make depth recede right. OUTPUT REQUIREMENT: native RGBA transparency is mandatory; outside the subject and its integral miniature base, every pixel must have alpha=0. Preserve clean antialiased alpha edges and soft translucent alpha only for smoke or similar integral effects. Do not render, draw, or bake a checkerboard, transparency-preview grid, black or white field, solid backdrop, gradient, glow, halo, vignette, cast shadow, or any other background representation into RGB. Do not depict any environment, scenery, surface, or backdrop. Do not include incidental text or text-like marks: no unrequested letters, numbers, words, prices, menus, labels, signage, graffiti, license-plate characters, or pseudo-glyphs on any surface. If the content section explicitly requests a brand logo, render that logo—including its authentic embedded lettering—and no other text. Replace all other signage with blank color panels or simple geometric decoration. Match the original Machi Koro illustration language: compact self-contained composition, loose playful perspective, chunky simplified shapes, low detail density, clean outlines, and simple graphic shading. Render the supplied Russian/post-Soviet everyday subject in a colder, grimmer palette without increasing realism. Preserve the cute board-game miniature style while letting the chosen object and its recognition details carry the post-Soviet bleakness.
